user.title: Kotiakku go-e Direct
user.description: Direct lot/amp/psm/frc surplus plus per-charger charge windows. Controller is read-only. Do not also enable the YAML surplus automations.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Charger 1 is required. Chargers 2–4 are optional. Pick any entity on each go-e charger device (car state is ideal). Serials and leftover priorities are asked next — MQTT uses the serial, not the entity id.

serials.title: Charger serials
serials.description: MQTT writes go-eCharger/<serial>/…/set. That is the device serial, not the Home Assistant entity id (entity ids can be renamed). Leftover priority is 1–99 (1 is highest), same scale as the go-e app. Prefill: {serial_hint}

house.title: Controller and Kotiakku
house.description: Pick the sensors in this Home Assistant. Controller is the go-e Controller Car-power 5-min mean used to add EV watts back into leftover. Never written to. Kotiakku sensors are read-only. Off-sun / Supercheap uses remaining-today and tomorrow solar energy (kWh) to shape expected kWh per hour, not Kotiakku PV power.

data.controller_in_kw: Controller sensor is in kW (off = watts)
data.kotiakku_in_kw: Kotiakku power sensors are in kW

init.title: Configure Kotiakku go-e Direct
init.description: Charger 1 is required; chargers 2–4 are optional. Each charger is an entity, MQTT serial, and leftover priority (1 = highest). MQTT publishes to go-eCharger/<serial>/set. Surplus numbers, ECO phase, window bounds, Enough solar, policies, and priority knobs live on the Kotiakku go-e Direct device.
